payloadRole: Top-level payload is chk-summary.log, the G-F3 tool-check summary at the clean exact merge (one line per command with exit code, start and end). additionalPayloads are byte copies of the npm ci log, the built-image run output (summary, manifest, evidence.jsonl, twenty-two server logs), the inspection and git-fact notes and the tool-check logs. G-OWN: no tracked trace, log, screenshot or DB file; raw output stays outside Git.

additionalPayloads.name: npm-ci.log
additionalPayloads.note: fresh npm ci in the clean worktree (heavy-run build ticket)

additionalPayloads.name: inspect-run.txt
additionalPayloads.note: witness sequence, image hashes and file hashes computed from the run output

additionalPayloads.name: git-facts.txt
additionalPayloads.note: ancestry, tree equality and leaf blob identities at the clean exact merge
